assistant|recipe_suggestion: Mocha chocolate cake with caramel ganache frosting recipe: 2¾ cups flour, 1½ cups sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup cocoa, 1 cup milk, 2 eggs, 1 tsp vanilla; bake 350°F for 35-40 min
Caramel ganache frosting: 1 cup heavy cream, 1 cup sugar, 2 tbsp butter, 1 tsp sea salt, 1 cup dark chocolate chips; simmer 5-7 min to amber, chill 2+ hours
Lemon cake variations suggested: lemon lavender pound cake, lemon blueberry, lemon curd, lemon poppyseed with twist, lemon chiffon, lemon-ginger
Lavender incorporation options: 1-2 tsp dried buds, ¼ tsp lavender extract, or 1-2 tbsp lavender syrup; infused sugar or milk methods
Lemon lavender pound cake recipe: 1½ cups butter, 1¾ cups sugar, 4 eggs, 2 tsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 2¼ cups flour, 1 cup buttermilk, 1 tsp dried lavender; bake 325°F for 55-60 min
Chewy chocolate chip cookies recipe: 2¼ cups flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 cup butter, ¾ cup each white and brown sugar, 2 eggs, 2 cups chocolate chips; bake 375°F for 10-12 min
assistant|recipe_adjustment: Updated lemon lavender pound cake with 1 cup granulated sugar + ½ cup brown sugar, 1½ tsp lemon zest, 1½ tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp ground dried lavender buds
assistant|storage_advice: Lemon lavender pound cake storage: room temp up to 3 days, refrigerator up to 5 days, freezer up to 2 months
assistant|baking_tip: Chewy cookie tips: mix white and brown sugar, room temp butter, don't overmix, don't overbake, chill dough, use extra moisture source
